# brig vm-runner screenshot

Save the screen of a VM that an agent started as PNG

## Synopsis

```text
brig vm-runner screenshot ID
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-f, --file string` | the file to write (default: ID.png) |
| `--service string` | the vm runner service (default: the only one) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
